lineage.description: Population density was derived from Kenya National Bureau of Statistics census data for 1989, calculated as total population divided by area (km²) at administrative division levels (province, district, division, location, sublocation). Data are provided in both vector (shapefile) and tabular (CSV) formats with demographic breakdowns by sex and household counts.

sources.description: National census data providing population counts and administrative boundaries for Kenya in 1989, used to derive population density metrics at sub-national administrative levels.
